@@ -197,7 +197,8 @@ Software can query the capability bounds:
 * The _base_ is returned by the <<GCBASE>> instruction.
 * The _length_ is returned by the <<GCLEN>> instruction.
 ** <<GCLEN>> saturates the _length_ to XLEN bits
-* The _top_ can be calculated using a saturating addition of the <<GCBASE>> and <<GCLEN>> results.
+* The _top_ is returned by the <<GCTOP>> instruction.
+** If {rvy_topr_insn_ext_name} is implemented, otherwise the _top_ can be calculated using a saturating addition of the <<GCBASE>> and <<GCLEN>> results.

+[#section_rvy_topr_insn_ext,reftext="{rvy_topr_insn_ext_name}"]
+== "{rvy_topr_insn_ext_name}" Extension for Extracting the Top Bound
+
+#Begin changed since last ARC review#
+
+The {rvy_topr_insn_ext_name} extension adds the <<GCTOP>> instruction to return the top bound of a capability.
+This offers a performance improvement over the software sequence of a saturating add of the results of <<GCBASE>> and <<GCLEN>>, and is useful fo rmemory allacators.
+
+#End changed since last ARC review#
+
+=== Added instructions
+
+include::insns/gctop_32bit.adoc[]
